summary: BP PLC filed a 6-K announcing the permanent appointment of Ian Tyler as Chair, effective immediately, after serving as Interim Chair since May 2026. The appointment follows an extensive internal and external search and was unanimously approved by the board. Dame Amanda Blanc, Senior Independent Director, will step down at the 2027 AGM. No financial terms are disclosed. This is a routine leadership succession, not a forced departure, so it is classified conservatively with medium confidence. Watch for governance evolution and shareholder engagement initiatives under Tyler's chairmanship.
